mathematical_sources.location: Weighted tube estimate and Kakeya maximal corollary
mathematical_sources.note: Included verbatim for provenance. Its title page says Working manuscript and does not give bibliographic authors. It was developed in this project, is not independently peer reviewed, and is not a claim of an externally published source. The formal proof replaces its mixed-determinant trace step by smooth comparison, sublevel estimates, layer cake, and Young's inequality. It also includes dimension two and scales up to one. The manuscript's optimality assertions are outside the formal scope.
